subject: Crestwell Health — Sales → CS: Implementation kickoff & prework
messages:
From: Connor O'Brien <connor.obrien@redwood.ai>
To: Monica Patel <monica.patel@redwood.ai>, Laura Bennett <laura.bennett@redwood.ai>, Karthik Iyer <karthik_iyer@redwood.ai>
Cc: Daniel Park <daniel.park@crestwellhealth.com>, Emily Zhao <emily.zhao@crestwellhealth.com>, procurement@crestwellhealth.com
Date: Mon, 02 Aug 2026 09:12:00 -0700
Subject: Crestwell Health — Sales → CS: Implementation kickoff & prework

Hi team,

Looping you in to start the Sales→CS handoff for Crestwell (Deal RW-9821). Quick context: Crestwell signed the Dedicated plan for inference (3 reserved GPU nodes, pin to rw-opt-gpt-13B, SLA target p95 < 220ms). Annual contract executed; PO in procurement thread. Proposed go-live target: Oct 15, 2026 (customer is aggressive but flexible).

Key items and known constraints:
- Model: rw-opt-gpt-13B (quantized to int8) — we already have a verified performance profile.
- Data: PHI-adjacent clinical summaries; Crestwell requested private VPC deployment and KMS integration.
- Compliance: customer requires SOC2 Type II evidence and a short audit timeline (they asked to start evidence collection ASAP).
- Networking: customer will request VPC peering / private link; see attached prelim network diagram.

Attachments: Crestwell_SOW_v1.pdf (signed SOW), network_prelim_diagram.png, crestwell_requirements.xlsx
HubSpot: https://app.hubspot.com/deal/9821
DocuSign envelope: https://www.docusign.com/crestdoc/RW-9821

Requested next steps (from Sales):
1) CS to confirm owner for kickoff and pre-kick tasks by EOD tomorrow.
2) Recommend two kickoff windows next week (we proposed 8/5 AM PT or 8/6 PM PT) — customer prefers mornings.
3) Please review the SOW and highlight any ops blockers (network/certs/KMS) and list prerequisites we must confirm before provisioning.

Monica / Laura / Karthik — over to you for ownership and an initial plan of attack. I’ll stay on thread for the first 2 weeks to smooth the transition.

Thanks,
Connor
Sales, Redwood Inference
From: Monica Patel <monica.patel@redwood.ai>
To: Connor O'Brien <connor.obrien@redwood.ai>, Laura Bennett <laura.bennett@redwood.ai>, Karthik Iyer <karthik_iyer@redwood.ai>
Cc: Daniel Park <daniel.park@crestwellhealth.com>, Emily Zhao <emily.zhao@crestwellhealth.com>, procurement@crestwellhealth.com
Date: Mon, 02 Aug 2026 11:03:00 -07:00
Subject: Re: Crestwell Health — Sales → CS: Implementation kickoff & prework

Thanks Connor — I’ll take primary ownership for the CS kickoff and delivery.

Pre-kick checklist (initial):
- Confirming signatory SOW and PO (Connor: please confirm procurement thread has final PO number).
- KMS integration: confirm which KMS (AWS KMS vs. customer HSM). We will need IAM role and KMS key ARN.
- Network: request for private link + IP ranges; ask for firewall rules. Laura will validate port requirements.
- SOC2 artifacts: we have baseline SOC2 package (control matrix, SOC2 report summary). I will start the evidence request list.
- Identity & SSO: does Crestwell want SAML SSO + SCIM for RBAC? Daniel — please confirm the IdP (Okta, Azure AD, other).

Proposed immediate owner assignments:
- Monica Patel: overall Implementation PM and SOC2 evidence coordinator.
- Laura Bennett: Network & infra readiness + provisioning (VPC peering, subnets, firewall guidance).
- Karthik Iyer: Customer engineering contact (integration points, sample prompts, eval sets).

I’ll propose a 45-min kickoff agenda and send a calendar invite once Daniel confirms the kickoff window.

Action: Daniel — can you confirm your preferred kickoff date/time next week and the IdP vendor?

Monica
Customer Success Lead
Redwood Inference
From: Daniel Park <daniel.park@crestwellhealth.com>
To: Monica Patel <monica.patel@redwood.ai>, Connor O'Brien <connor.obrien@redwood.ai>, Laura Bennett <laura.bennett@redwood.ai>
Cc: Emily Zhao <emily.zhao@crestwellhealth.com>, procurement@crestwellhealth.com
Date: Tue, 03 Aug 2026 08:24:00 -07:00
Subject: Re: Crestwell Health — Sales → CS: Implementation kickoff & prework

Hi all — thanks for the handoff. Quick answers from Crestwell:
- Kickoff: Prefer Thurs 8/05 at 09:30 PT (works for Daniel, Emily, and our Principal Architect Sam Li).
- IdP: Okta (will provide SAML metadata and SCIM details).
- KMS: We plan to use AWS KMS (customer-managed keys). We will provide key ARNs but need guidance on rotation windows.
- Procurement: PO will be issued by tomorrow EOD. Procurement contact (procurement@crestwellhealth.com) is CC’d.
- Data retention: We need a 7-year retention policy for audit logs and a way to export logs on request — is that supported in Private deployment?

Also, Sam asked if you support a pre-prod validation window where we can run our 3rd-party red-team scans against a staging instance. On that, we will need a temp network configuration (VPN) and clear rules for scope.

I can join the kickoff on 8/05.

Thanks,
Daniel
Director, IT Architecture
Crestwell Health
From: Laura Bennett <laura.bennett@redwood.ai>
To: Monica Patel <monica.patel@redwood.ai>, Karthik Iyer <karthik_iyer@redwood.ai>, Connor O'Brien <connor.obrien@redwood.ai>
Cc: Daniel Park <daniel.park@crestwellhealth.com>, Emily Zhao <emily.zhao@crestwellhealth.com>
Date: Wed, 04 Aug 2026 09:18:00 -07:00
Subject: Re: Crestwell Health — Sales → CS: Implementation kickoff & prework

Thanks Daniel — booking Thurs 8/05 09:30 PT for kickoff (45 mins). I’ve created a shared Ops checklist (shortlink in related links).

Immediate operational notes and owners: 
- Networking (Laura): I’ll circulate exact port/endpoint requirements and a template for the VPC peering request. Please provide Crestwell IPs and preferred peering times.
- KMS (Monica + Infra): We support AWS KMS; Monica please request Key ARN and a cross-account role for Redwood to use (we will provide least-privilege policy).
- Logs & Retention (Karthik): Private deployment supports configurable retention. Karthik — can you confirm how exportable logs are (S3 export / GCS) and the retention enforcement mechanism? Aim to have an answer by kickoff.
- Security testing: we allow staged security scans in a pre-prod window with approved scope and a signed NDA amendment. We will need CVE handling SLA agreement during the scan window.

Action item table (brief):
- Connor: confirm PO and attach final PO number to HubSpot.
- Monica: SOC2 artifact package + evidence request list (by 8/04 EOD).
- Laura: VPC template + port list (by 8/04 EOD).
- Karthik: Logging/export notes + staging scan process doc (by kickoff).

I’ll send the calendar invite for 8/05 09:30 PT and include a short agenda (kickoff, scope, pre-provision checklist, next steps).

Laura Bennett
Implementation Lead, Redwood Inference
From: Connor O'Brien <connor.obrien@redwood.ai>
To: Monica Patel <monica.patel@redwood.ai>, Laura Bennett <laura.bennett@redwood.ai>, Karthik Iyer <karthik_iyer@redwood.ai>
Cc: Daniel Park <daniel.park@crestwellhealth.com>, Emily Zhao <emily.zhao@crestwellhealth.com>, procurement@crestwellhealth.com
Date: Wed, 04 Aug 2026 16:20:00 -07:00
Subject: Re: Crestwell Health — Sales → CS: Implementation kickoff & prework

All — thanks for the quick responses. Confirming handoff is complete and Monica is the primary CS owner; Laura is the infra lead; Karthik is technical integration lead. I’ll monitor for the first two sprints and close my sales ticket once PO is attached to HubSpot.

Final notes to include in kickoff:
- Target milestones: Provisioning week (8/9), Functional validation (9/20–9/30), Pilot go-live (10/15).
- Risks: SOC2 evidence timing, KMS cross-account role delay, procurement timing.

Connor
Sales, Redwood Inference
